answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 1823 Country: India Title: What is the basic differences between "Kashf" and "Ilm-e-ghaib"? Question: What is the basic differences between "Kashf" and "Ilm-e-ghaib"? Answer ID: 1823 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1128/1057=B) Ilm-e-Gaib is to know all that happened in past and that will happen in future; this is an exclusive attribute of Allah alone. While, Kashf is a state of heart in which the inner feelings of other is revealed to one. This is achieved by a kind of rehearsal and spiritual exercise; even non-Muslim jogis can have it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
